limitations: Comparison reference is the existing Python fine-stack model, not surveyed ground truth; Nobile ground is outside its fine patches.
Annual ephemerides share the existing DE440 implementation, evaluated at each terrain ground+2m.
Three published illumination checks use the existing synthetic long-term visible-disc model, not dated annual centre visibility.
Cold browser profile delivery excludes server-side preparation, initial module imports and UI rendering.
Main horizon grid uses 5 m ray spacing below23km and60m beyond, ending150020m; three mosaic-only convergence probes use5m far spacing.
No production engine, service, UI or published data is changed.
